description: standard install and standard list (spec/cli/kits.md, "Commands"). Each case runs in a new project made with the project's args and committed to git, with the catalogue unreachable. A case with change appends that text to the file, uncommitted, first. The output is exact, or, with outputStarts, begins so: the rest is git's reason.
